# SaltWatch Card 0.5.5

This release restores the balanced tank-only composition shown in earlier SaltWatch Card versions.

## What changed

- The tank is narrower and centered again instead of filling nearly the entire card width.
- The LOW pill has a clearly separated ruler gutter before the tank, matching the intended reference layout.
- The threshold line once again begins behind the LOW pill and ends at the tank window.
- The pill remains safely inside the card at narrow dashboard widths.
- Browser regression coverage now includes the 644-pixel reference layout as well as narrow and combined-card layouts.

## Compatibility

- Existing card configurations continue to work without changes.
- No dashboard YAML changes are required.
- The emulator and SaltWatch firmware are unaffected.

## Validation

- 49 unit tests passed.
- 43 browser tests passed across desktop and mobile profiles; one desktop-only mobile-scroll test was skipped as intended.
- The production TypeScript and Vite build passed.
- The release workflow rebuilds and publishes the checked JavaScript asset.
